transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um... I guess I'm here because I've been having some trouble with... eating. Like, after work or my classes, I'll just sit down with my laptop and... I don't know, I just end up eating a lot. 

I'll have a whole takeout meal, and then I just keep going with chips, sweets... whatever snacks I have stuffed in my desk drawer. It's... it's way more than I ever plan to eat. And I definitely wouldn't eat like that if anyone else was around. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
After you eat a lot like that, do you ever make yourself sick or use laxatives to try to get rid of the food?
Um... no. I don't... I don't do that.
When you're eating a lot like that, do you ever feel like you can't stop or control what you're doing?

Um... yeah. I guess so. It's... it's hard to explain. Once I start, it just feels like I'm... watching myself. Like I just keep reaching for the next thing, even while I'm thinking in my head... *Jaime, stop, you have a budget report to finish*. And... I'm not even enjoying it anymore at that point. But I just... yeah. I can't really stop.
When you're eating a lot during these times, do you find yourself eating much more quickly than usual?
Um... I don't know. I guess maybe? I haven't really paid attention to how fast I'm eating.
Do you usually eat alone during these times because you're embarrassed about how much you're eating?

Um... yeah. I do. I usually... I wait until my roommate is out, or... until my family goes to bed. I just... I try to act pretty put-together and health-conscious during the day, so... I guess I'd just be really embarrassed if anyone saw how much I was actually eating.
Do these episodes of eating a lot cause you a lot of distress, or interfere with your daily life in any way?

Um... yeah, I guess it does. I mean... I've been saying no to things lately. Like, my friends wanted to do this big cooking night recently, and I just... I made up an excuse. I just get so worried that they'll somehow know, or... notice something. So I just stay home a lot more now, unless I have to go to work or classes. It's just easier to be by myself.
Do these episodes where you eat a lot happen within a short period of time, like a couple of hours, or do they usually spread out more throughout the evening or day?

Um... I guess it's usually pretty fast. Like, just in a short window of time. Usually after I get home from work or class, I'll... I just sit down with my laptop and it all kind of happens then. 

I'll end up eating a whole takeout meal, and then... chips, or sweets... just whatever snacks I have stashed in my desk drawer. It's... it's way more than I ever plan to eat when I sit down. And definitely more than I'd ever eat if someone else was in the room. But yeah... it's usually just all at once, not really spread out.
